title: cfDNA Scale Tradeoff Audit: reproducible analysis of normalization scale and cross-study score transport
description: Software v0.2.0 for the normalization-scale audit of public cfDNA cohorts. Includes source-only calibration, repeated real-patient anchors, post-hoc exploratory shared-depth and GI-versus-HCC analyses, chromosome-block inference, PERMDISP, complete numeric CSV outputs and current figures. Third-party data retain their original terms.
